name: TabZilla: Hard Benchmark Suite for Tabular Deep Learning vs. Gradient Boosted Trees
description: TabZilla is a standardized, rigorously curated benchmark suite designed to evaluate tabular deep learning architectures against gradient boosted decision trees. Created by researchers from Abacus.AI, University of Maryland, and CMU, it selects the 36 hardest tabular classification datasets across 176 candidates with standardized 10-fold cross-validation splits and systematic hyperparameter tuning pipelines.
